say:3:1524650001:0.text: Look, it's <style="stress"><player_name></style>! So you're the mage Gala sent to help us!
say:3:1524650001:0.male: Look, it's <style="stress"><player_name></style>! So you're the mage Gala sent to help us!
say:3:1524650001:0.female: Look, it's <style="stress"><player_name></style>! So you're the mage Gala sent to help us!

say:4:1524650002:1.text: I've heard so much about your amazing deeds! With you around, this hunt is sure to go well.
say:4:1524650002:1.source_cn: 你的实力我们早有耳闻，有你帮忙，这次围猎的结果肯定不错。
say:4:1524650002:1.male: I've heard so much about your amazing deeds! With you around, this hunt is sure to go well.
say:4:1524650002:1.female: I've heard so much about your amazing deeds! With you around, this hunt is sure to go well.

say:5:1524650003:1.text: All the hunters are here, we're just discussing what bait to use to lure the beast out.
say:5:1524650003:1.source_cn: 狩猎队的队员都已经到齐了，我们现在正在讨论用什么诱饵把...
say:5:1524650003:1.male: All the hunters are here, we're just discussing what bait to use to lure the beast out.
say:5:1524650003:1.female: All the hunters are here, we're just discussing what bait to use to lure the beast out.

say:6:1524650004:1.text: How about using the usual bait, but adding more?
say:6:1524650004:1.source_cn: 就用平时的诱饵，多放几个怎么样？

say:7:1524650005:1.text: The beast is clever enough to cover its tracks. The usual bait won't cut it.
say:7:1524650005:1.source_cn: 这野兽狡猾得很，那么多次都没暴露过踪迹，普通的诱饵恐怕...

say:8:1524650006:1.text: Since we found its footprints by the river, maybe we can use large chunks of fish to lure it.
say:8:1524650006:1.source_cn: 我们是在河流边发现它活动痕迹的，说不定用大块鱼肉能行。

say:9:1524650007:1.text: Very well, let's <style="highlight">catch some big fish</style> as bait.
